title: Lean correspondence for the reading examples
author: Komorebi P.

groups.hypotheses: N, j, n are arbitrary natural numbers, including zero. Lane starts are j+1+r for 0 <= r < N.
groups.conclusion: j! times the product of all N step-N lanes of length n equals (N*n+j)!.

groups.hypotheses: Natural a, n, j, and positive natural N. Pochhammer is the actual finite product over Q.
groups.conclusion: Exact rational lane scaling, full N-parameter factorial factorization, and the unit-parameter n! identity.
groups.excluded: The separate literal nine-parameter extraction and equality of analytic or formal-series 0F9 objects are not formalized.

sections: 5: The same reciprocal recurrence before normalization
groups.hypotheses: m,j are natural; the diagonal bridge additionally requires q <= m. Rational arithmetic, with nonzero denominator proofs.
groups.conclusion: Factorial normalization equals 1/binomial(m+j,j). The original and normalized reciprocal rows have equal scalar coefficients.
groups.excluded: No full power-series inverse construction or prime-adic precision theorem is asserted.

groups.hypotheses: Coefficient sequences N -> A with A an additive commutative monoid. Reconstruction requires a positive modulus. Refinement requires a positive fine modulus M and N divides M.
groups.conclusion: Coefficient masks are orthogonal idempotents; all residues reconstruct the sequence; divisible refinement reconstructs each coarse packet.
groups.excluded: This is not the complex roots-of-unity averaging identity.

groups.hypotheses: Actual additive equivalence V ≃+ W on specified additive commutative monoids. Generic family results require the respective source-family laws. Residue specializations use full sequence carriers.
groups.conclusion: Coordinate transfer preserves composition, projector laws, and finite reconstruction. Complete input/output packet blocks reconstruct the transported operation.
groups.excluded: The concrete polynomial Stirling basis equivalence is not constructed. Infinite sequences are not identified with finite polynomials.

groups.hypotheses: Arbitrary x : Fin(n+1) -> Q, n a natural number including zero. Sampling requires n+1 distinct rational addresses.
groups.conclusion: The actual polynomial sum k! x_k X^k retains every coordinate. Coefficient division recovers it. Equality at n+1 distinct addresses determines the profile uniquely.
groups.excluded: The constructive Newton interpolation algorithm and the derivative-expression recovery formula are not formalized. No positive-characteristic division claim.

groups.hypotheses: Five-coordinate rational profiles. Genuine v=(0,1,7,6,1), candidate w=(0,5,2,7,1).
groups.conclusion: Both distinct nonnegative profiles have summaries (15,75), so the two-summary map is not injective. Their full weighted polynomials differ at 2 with values 730 and 746.
groups.excluded: w is not another Stirling row. One additional address is not claimed to identify an arbitrary profile.

groups.hypotheses: Arbitrary natural n, identity in the actual polynomial ring Q[X].
groups.conclusion: X^n equals the sum of S(n,k) times the kth descending Pochhammer polynomial.
groups.attribution: Uses the existing pinned Mathlib theorem Nat.pow_eq_sum_stirlingSecond_mul_descFactorial at natural-number evaluation addresses and polynomial equality on an infinite set. Classical identity; no novelty claim.
groups.excluded: No signed-Stirling inverse, moment integral, EGF, or roots-of-unity identity is formalized.

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.stepFactorial_zero
declarations.signature: theorem stepFactorial_zero (a N : ℕ) : stepFactorial a 0 N = 1

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.stepFactorial_succ
declarations.signature:
theorem stepFactorial_succ (a n N : ℕ) :
    stepFactorial a (n + 1) N = stepFactorial a n N * (a + N * n)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.factorial_block
declarations.signature:
theorem factorial_block (a N : ℕ) :
    Nat.factorial a * (∏ r ∈ Finset.range N, (a + 1 + r)) =
      Nat.factorial (a + N)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.laneProduct_zero
declarations.signature: theorem laneProduct_zero (N j : ℕ) : laneProduct N j 0 = 1

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.laneProduct_succ
declarations.signature:
theorem laneProduct_succ (N j n : ℕ) :
    laneProduct N j (n + 1) = laneProduct N j n *
      (∏ r ∈ Finset.range N, (N * n + j + 1 + r))

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.factorial_lane_reconstruction
declarations.signature:
theorem factorial_lane_reconstruction (N j n : ℕ) :
    Nat.factorial j * laneProduct N j n = Nat.factorial (N * n + j)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.ten_lane_reconstruction
declarations.signature:
theorem ten_lane_reconstruction (n : ℕ) :
    24 * laneProduct 10 4 n = Nat.factorial (10 * n + 4)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.pochhammer
declarations.signature: def pochhammer (a : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : ℚ

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.pochhammer_succ
declarations.signature:
theorem pochhammer_succ (a : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    pochhammer a (n + 1) = pochhammer a n * (a + n)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.stepFactorial_scale
declarations.signature:
theorem stepFactorial_scale (a n N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (stepFactorial a n N : ℚ) = (N : ℚ) ^ n * pochhammer ((a : ℚ) / N) n

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.pochhammer_one
declarations.signature: theorem pochhammer_one (n : ℕ) : pochhammer 1 n = (Nat.factorial n : ℚ)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.factorial_pochhammer
declarations.signature:
theorem factorial_pochhammer (N j n : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (Nat.factorial j : ℚ) * (N : ℚ) ^ (N * n) *
      (∏ r ∈ Finset.range N, pochhammer ((j + 1 + r : ℕ) / (N : ℚ)) n) =
      (Nat.factorial (N * n + j) : ℚ)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.normalized_coefficient
declarations.signature:
theorem normalized_coefficient (m j : ℕ) :
    (Nat.factorial j : ℚ) * (Nat.factorial m : ℚ) /
      (Nat.factorial (m + j) : ℚ) = 1 / (Nat.choose (m + j) j : ℚ)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.FactorialLanes.binomial_diagonal_bridge
declarations.signature:
theorem binomial_diagonal_bridge (m q j : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ m) :
    (Nat.choose (m + j) q : ℚ) / (Nat.choose (m + j) j : ℚ) =
      (Nat.choose m q : ℚ) / (Nat.choose (m - q + j) j : ℚ)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.project
declarations.signature: def project (N r : ℕ) : (ℕ → A) →+ (ℕ → A)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.project_apply
declarations.signature:
@[simp] theorem project_apply (N r : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (k : ℕ) :
    project N r a k = if k % N = r then a k else 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.project_idempotent
declarations.signature:
theorem project_idempotent (N r : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) :
    project N r (project N r a) = project N r a

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.project_orthogonal
declarations.signature:
theorem project_orthogonal (N : ℕ) {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≠ s) (a : ℕ → A) :
    project N r (project N s a) = 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.reconstruct
declarations.signature:
theorem reconstruct {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (a : ℕ → A) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, project N r a) = a

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.project_refined_packet
declarations.signature:
theorem project_refined_packet {N M : ℕ} (hNM : N ∣ M)
    (r s : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) :
    project N r (project M s a) =
      if s % N = r then project M s a else 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.refinement
declarations.signature:
theorem refinement {N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hNM : N ∣ M)
    (r : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) :
    project N r a =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.range M, if s % N = r then project M s a else 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer
declarations.signature: def coordinateTransfer (e : V ≃+ W) (T : V →+ V) : W →+ W

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_apply
declarations.signature:
@[simp] theorem coordinateTransfer_apply (e : V ≃+ W) (T : V →+ V) (w : W) :
    coordinateTransfer e T w = e (T (e.symm w))

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_on_coordinates
declarations.signature:
theorem coordinateTransfer_on_coordinates (e : V ≃+ W)
    (T : V →+ V) (v : V) :
    coordinateTransfer e T (e v) = e (T v)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_comp
declarations.signature:
theorem coordinateTransfer_comp (e : V ≃+ W) (T U : V →+ V) :
    coordinateTransfer e (T.comp U) =
      (coordinateTransfer e T).comp (coordinateTransfer e U)

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_idempotent
declarations.signature:
theorem coordinateTransfer_idempotent (e : V ≃+ W) (P : V →+ V)
    (hP : ∀ v, P (P v) = P v) (w : W) :
    coordinateTransfer e P (coordinateTransfer e P w) = coordinateTransfer e P w

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_orthogonal
declarations.signature:
theorem coordinateTransfer_orthogonal (e : V ≃+ W) (P Q : V →+ V)
    (hPQ : ∀ v, P (Q v) = 0) (w : W) :
    coordinateTransfer e P (coordinateTransfer e Q w) = 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_reconstruct
declarations.signature:
theorem coordinateTransfer_reconstruct {I : Type*} (e : V ≃+ W)
    (P : I → V →+ V) (s : Finset I) (hP : ∀ v, ∑ i ∈ s, P i v = v) (w : W) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, coordinateTransfer e (P i) w) = w

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.coordinateTransfer_block_reconstruction
declarations.signature:
theorem coordinateTransfer_block_reconstruction {I J : Type*} (e : V ≃+ W)
    (T : V →+ V) (P : I → V →+ V) (Q : J → V →+ V) (s : Finset I) (t : Finset J)
    (hP : ∀ v, ∑ i ∈ s, P i v = v) (hQ : ∀ v, ∑ j ∈ t, Q j v = v) (w : W) :
    coordinateTransfer e T w =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, coordinateTransfer e (P i)
        (coordinateTransfer e T (coordinateTransfer e (Q j) w))

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transportedProject
declarations.signature: def transportedProject (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B) (N r : ℕ) : B →+ B

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transportedProject_apply
declarations.signature:
@[simp] theorem transportedProject_apply (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B)
    (N r : ℕ) (b : B) :
    transportedProject e N r b = e (project N r (e.symm b))

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transported_idempotent
declarations.signature:
theorem transported_idempotent (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B)
    (N r : ℕ) (b : B) :
    transportedProject e N r (transportedProject e N r b) =
      transportedProject e N r b

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transported_orthogonal
declarations.signature:
theorem transported_orthogonal (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B)
    (N : ℕ) {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≠ s) (b : B) :
    transportedProject e N r (transportedProject e N s b) = 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transported_reconstruct
declarations.signature:
theorem transported_reconstruct (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (b : B) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, transportedProject e N r b) = b

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transported_refinement
declarations.signature:
theorem transported_refinement (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B)
    {N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hNM : N ∣ M) (r : ℕ) (b : B) :
    transportedProject e N r b =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.range M, if s % N = r then transportedProject e M s b else 0

declarations.name: Komorebi.Reader.ResiduePackets.transfer_block_reconstruction
declarations.signature:
theorem transfer_block_reconstruction (e : (ℕ → A) ≃+ B)
    (T : (ℕ → A) →+ (ℕ → A)) {N M : ℕ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (b : B) :
    coordinateTransfer e T b =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ s ∈ Finset.range M,
        transportedProject e N r
          (coordinateTransfer e T (transportedProject e M s b))
